sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5097 of 2022

Applicant :- Satnam Singh S/O Jaswant (Second Bail)
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Jai Narayan Pandey,Amrendra Nath Tripathi,Anand Mani Tripathi,B
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
1.

This is second bail application as the first bail application of the applicant was rejected on 24.02.2022 bearing Bail No.10730 of 2021 by Hon. Ram Krishna Gautam,J.
2.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Brijendra Vikram Singh learned A.G.A. for the State.
3.

The new cause of action has arisen,therefore, the present second bail application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No.331 of 2021 under sections 376-D, 506 IPC, Police Station Pali, District Hardoi.

4. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that co-accused Baldev has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 17.02.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.13265 of 2021.The order of co-accused Baldev granting bail is quoted below:-

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
"Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
Satnam Singh S/O Jaswant (Second Bail) vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79190231/
1

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in F.I.R. No. 331 of 2021,
under Sections 376-D, 506 IPC, Police Station Pali, District Hardoi with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case by the prosecutrix, who is a major lady.
It is further submitted that as per prosecution case, the prosecutrix was raped by the two persons along with the applicant.

Learned counsel for the applicant vehemently submits that in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., though the prosecutrix stated that due to the act of the accused persons, she was unable to move, but the medico legal report does not support the prosecution story.
It is also submitted that the charge sheet has been filed by the Investigating Officer and there is no possibility of tampering of any evidence.
It is lastly submitted that the trial is not going on and the applicant, who has no criminal antecedent, is in jail since 30.07.2021.
In such circumstances, applicant is entitled for bail.
It is also submitted that the applicant will never misuse the liberty of bail and shall fully cooperate in the investigation.
Learned A.G.A. opposes the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant and submits that after detail investigation, charge sheet was filed by the Investigation Officer.

However, he does not dispute the fact that prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. categorically stated that two persons committed rape and she was not in a position to move, but no such injury was found in the medico legal report.

Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant,
learned A.G.A. and going through the contents of F.I.R., statements of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. as well as medico legal report and other relevant documents, it is evident that prosecutrix has stated that two persons committed rape with her and due to said offence, she was unable to move, but in the medical examination, no such sign was found on her genital parts.
In such circumstances, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

Let applicant -Baldev be released on bail in F.I.R. No. 331 of 2021, under Sections 376-D, 506 IPC, Police Station Pali, District Hardoi, on his furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(1) Applicant will not try to influence the witnesses or tamper with the evidence of the case or otherwise misuse the liberty of bail.
(2) Applicant will fully cooperate in expeditious disposal of the case and shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when witnesses are present in the Court.
Satnam Singh S/O Jaswant (Second Bail) vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79190231/
2 (3) Applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (a) opening of the case, (b) framing of charge; and (c) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.
Any violation of above conditions will be treated misuse of bail and learned Court below will be at liberty to pass appropriate order in the matter regarding cancellation of bail."
5.

entities.text: State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that while rejecting the bail application of the applicant, the Court was influenced that co-accused- Baldev was not identified by the prosecutrix and he was also not named in the FIR.
It has been submitted that while granting the bail of co-accused Baldev, the Court has considered the medical ground and the trial is going on.
The prosecutrix in her statement before the trial court has again identified the co-accused Baldev and deposed before the court that he also committed rape against her.

It has been submitted that it is established that co-accused Baldev has also committed rape and his bail has been granted,
therefore, the case of the applicant is at par with the case of co-accused Baldev.

Learned counsel for the applicant has further submitted that there are contradictions in the statement of the prosecutrix and she is unable to prove prosecution case because the place of occurrence has been shown on different places.

The applicant has no previous criminal history and there is no possibility of fleeing away from the judicial process or tempering with the witnesses and in case, the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail.
The applicant is in jail since 24.07.2021.
It has been submitted that the co-ordinate Bench while granting bail to co-accused Baldev, has found that medical report of the prosecutrix is not corresponding with the prosecution case.

6. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that this is second bail application and the allegation of rape has been levelled by the prosecutrix as such the bail application of the applicant is liable to be rejected.

7. Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and after hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking into overall facts and circumstances of the case as well as the fact that co-accused Baldev has been granted bail, I find it a fit case for bail 8.

Let the applicant, namely,Satnam Singh, be released on bail in the above case crime number on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Court concerned with the following conditions :-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

3

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.

It is made clear that the observations made in this order are limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
The Trial Court shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led unaffected by anything in this order.

The Trial Court shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led unaffected by anything in this order.
